title: Profile of Organisations that Received Disbursements from Cultural Matching Fund
what_it_is: Profile of Organisations that Received Disbursements from Cultural Matching Fund

sections.label: CMF arts heritage funding breakdown
sections.summary: About six in 10 qualifying arts and heritage charities received CMF funding, with amounts broken down by recipient type and sector.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Among the arts and heritage charities that qualify for CMF, about six out of 10 have applied for and received funding from CMF.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The amount matched by CMF comprised $65 million for 12 national companies and museums; $33 million for 36 Major Grant and Seed Grant companies; and $54 million for 37 other charities supporting arts and heritage causes.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The breakdown by sector is as follows: $23 million for visual arts; $40 million for performing arts; $0.6 million for literary arts; $24 million for traditional arts; $20 million for heritage, and $44 million for the remaining groups.

sections.label: CMF review and eligibility rules
sections.summary: The Ministry is reviewing CMF and considering a new tranche; all arts and heritage charities and IPCs are eligible, with certain donations excluded.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Indeed, the Ministry is currently reviewing CMF and we are looking at the possibility of a new tranche when it runs out.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: All arts and heritage charities and Institutions of a Public Character (IPCs) are eligible for CMF.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: CMF will also only consider cash donations that are certified by a certified public accountant or auditor.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: CMF will also not match grants given by the Government or Statutory Boards, donations from ComChest, President's Challenge or similar entities.

sections.label: CMF funding cap for recipients
sections.summary: A $15 million funding cap per CMF recipient is in place so national companies and museums do not crowd out smaller organisations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: However, we are mindful that our national companies and museums should not crowd out the other smaller arts and heritage organisations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Therefore, we have put in place a $15 million funding cap for each CMF recipient.
